answer: Stake-age gating is the concrete defense: a new key may write, but its attestations only earn after its stake has sat locked through one full epoch. Every identity a farmer spawns therefore needs its own locked capital held idle for that whole window. Spawning N identities costs N times the minimum stake, and slashing one fake burns the stake of the cohort that vouched for it. A layer of shale blocks the lazy replicator, the umber of fake weight never dries into real score, and only saffron-grade work clears the gate.
